zh.title: 一条删除请求会走多远
zh.question: 删掉一条原话事件后，哪些内容被直接移除、被标记失效、需要重算，又有哪些根本无法证明已抹除？
zh.assumption: 全部为合成教学数据，不含任何真实用户内容；分类只依据数据里显式记录的来源关系，不模拟真实删除协议，也不代表任何产品的实际行为。
zh.observe: 观察：失效 ≠ 已验证的物理删除。走到系统边界外和没有 lineage 的节点时，删除请求就失去了证据。

en.title: How far does one delete request travel?
en.question: After deleting one source event, what is removed directly, marked invalidated, or recomputed—and what can never be proven erased?
en.assumption: All synthetic teaching data, no real user content; classification follows only the explicitly recorded source relationships, simulates no real deletion protocol, and represents no product's actual behavior.
en.observe: Observe: invalidation is not verified physical deletion. At the system boundary and where lineage is missing, the delete request runs out of evidence.
en.selectLabel: Source events covered by the request
en.invalidationNote: Invalidation is not verified physical deletion: this only marks derived conclusions unusable and never claims the data vanished from every medium.
